title: Understanding Random Forests
text: Random forests are an ensemble learning method that constructs multiple decision trees during training and outputs the mode of their classes. They can capture complex patterns and interactions between features.

title: Decision Boundaries in Random Forests
text: Random forests can create non-linear decision boundaries by combining the outputs of multiple decision trees. This allows them to model complex patterns in the data.

title: Analyzing the Data Distribution
